name: mcp_tool_sanitize_mcp_name_component
notes: MCP tool-name component sanitizer (mcp_tool.c::mcp_tool_sanitize_mcp_name_component vs LIVE tools/mcp_tool.py::sanitize_mcp_name_component). DOCUMENTED DIVERGENCE (excluded): LIVE maps '-' to '_' but the C port preserves hyphens, so hyphen-bearing inputs are not exercised; also the C port loops over UTF-8 bytes where LIVE iterates codepoints, so non-ASCII inputs are excluded too.
